summary: Denies the Workflow tool before a research request starts a multi-agent run without explicit approval.
doc: This hook denies every call to the Workflow tool. A user who asks for deep or thorough research wants a thorough answer, but a multi-agent run can spend a very large number of tokens before anyone sees a result. The denial tells the model to read the primary sources itself, run a few targeted searches, and write the answer. If the request needs a fan-out, the denial tells the model to ask with a cost estimate. The hook has no escape flag. Run npx guardhooks remove block-workflow-fanout to allow the Workflow tool again.
